source_agreement: MainTable1 location matches rounded midpoint of TableS3 start/finish. TableS3 printed midpoint and TableS1 interval disagree. Coordinate conflict is real but these are not three mutually discordant independent assays.
assembly_caution: No original-source assembly harmonization or guessed interval substitution performed. Exact hg38 envelope is determined by genomic sequences, not by treating old coordinates as hg38.
sequence_caution: Supplement describes corresponding genomic DNA sequences for locating bisulfite primer sequences. Placement envelope is not a new PCR design, entire control DMR or genome-wide specificity assay.
